questions.stem: What is the main idea of the chapter 'Walls Tell Stories'?
choices: Walls can talk and tell us about the people who lived long ago

questions.stem: What can we learn from old items kept in a museum?
choices: How people lived in the past
How to build modern structures
How to make money
How to play games
questions.solution: Old items in a museum provide insights into the daily lives, customs, and technologies of earlier times. They show what people used, created, and valued, which helps us understand their way of life. The other options do not relate to the primary purpose of studying historical artifacts.
